title: Silver Plus Account: Transferring funds to external banks
summary: This document explains how Silver Plus Account external bank transfers work, including a typical 2-business-day processing timeline, a $10,000/day outbound limit to linked external accounts (multiple transfers combined), and guidance on paper statements ($0.00 monthly fee) for transfer verification without affecting processing.
faqs: How long do external transfers from a Silver Plus Account take to complete?

Can I enable paper statements in settings without impacting external transfer processing?
